_comment: Shared D6 load-factor vectors: the factor from a member exercise's load_input_mode (source) to the group exercise's (target), applied to 1RM only; Weight stays the raw entered kg. jest (groups-metric-contract.test.ts) runs them against groupEnteredWeightFactor; supabase/tests/groups-bodyweight.sh runs them against app_public.group_board_load_factor.
